claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled for launch no earlier than April 1, 2026.
Artemis II will send four astronauts on a 10-day crewed flyby around the Moon.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the lunar vicinity since 1972.
Artemis II will test the Orion capsule.
Artemis II will test the SLS rocket.
Artemis II is scheduled for launch in early April 2026 from NASA's Kennedy Space Center.
Artemis II duration is approximately 10 days.
Reid Wiseman is the Commander of Artemis II.
Victor Glover is the Pilot of Artemis II.
Christina Koch is a Mission Specialist of Artemis II from NASA.
Jeremy Hansen is a Mission Specialist of Artemis II from the Canadian Space Agency.
Artemis II will feature Victor Glover as the first Black man to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis II will feature Christina Koch as the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis II will feature Jeremy Hansen as the first non-American to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis II objectives include testing life support systems.
Artemis II objectives include demonstrating the capability to navigate deep space.
Artemis II objectives include preparing for future Artemis III moon landing missions.
Artemis I successfully completed an uncrewed flight test in 2022.
Artemis II is a crewed lunar flyby scheduled for 2026.
Artemis III and beyond aim to land the first woman and next man on the Moon.
Artemis III and beyond target the lunar South Pole to establish a long-term presence
